log_level.description: Global logging level. 4=ERROR, 3=WARNING, 2=INFO, 1=DEBUG. Highly discouraged in production.

log_filters.description: Space-separated logging filters in format 'level:match'. Overrides log_level for matching categories.

log_outputs.description: Space-separated logging outputs in format 'level:destination'. E.g. '3:syslog:virtlockd'.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections on the primary socket.

admin_max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections on the administrative socket.
